narration:2:1410437001:0.text: You step into line with the other commoners to receive the Divine Dew. Indris, despite clearly seeing the Stigma of Judgment upon you, chooses to ignore it. Without resistance, the dew is placed in your hands.
narration:2:1410437001:0.source_cn: 你跟随着其他平民排队领取恩典灵露，因度厄似乎对你不加掩...

narration:3:1410437002:0.text: You examine the Divine Dew, sensing the faint magic within. Although the magic is weak, with enough time, it really can keep the corruption at bay.
narration:3:1410437002:0.source_cn: 你探查这份灵露，发现其中蕴含了特殊的魔力……虽然含量很...

narration:4:1410437003:0.text: As you observe the line, you notice something—other marked commoners are receiving the dew as well. Indris, watching over the process, seems to be allowing this.
narration:4:1410437003:0.source_cn: 随后你仔细观察着队伍，同样有一些身负惩罚印记的平民获取...
